Name: Sweet Harvey
Author: SweetAppletun
Description:
Changes & adds to Harvey's post-marriage dialogue to make him a little bit more affectionate! Some of it is just lovey-dovey, others flirtier. Suggestive content but not explicit, since I think Harvey's the kind of guy to get too flustered to flirt directly, but plenty of allusions. Keeps some of his flirtier vanilla dialogue and alters most of the rest- though I may make a version with plenty of 'medically accurate' jokes if there's interest. This is currently a somewhat small expansion, but if there's more demand, I will also gladly add even more to this! (By 'more demand' I mean as long as literally anyone is interested)

[i]Features:
-New dialogue, usually weekly! Plenty of new lines to read.
-Dialogue to remind about birthdays, festivals, seasonal crops, and more!
-Edited Vanilla dialogue! Turns his flirty lines flirtier, and his normal lines flirty!
-Plenty of charm and affection both!
[/i]


[I don't believe this is compatible with any other Harvey Marriage dialogue mods because it replaces dialogue, but if it is, let me know and i'll fix this! I'm completely new to coding so I'm not entirely sure how it works. If there are any errors/typos/etc please drop a comment and I'll fix it ASAP!]
